scope: Horseshoe Bay, Texas; current sales, service and inventory pages were reviewed.

observations.title: Clarify the installed engine
observations.observed: The live 2019 South Bay 525RS 3.0 listing shows both 350 HP and 250 hp as engine power in the same expanded specifications panel.
observations.improvement: Confirm the installed engine and distinguish it from generic model specifications or limits. Reuse verified specifications across listing details.

observations.title: Bring the service request closer to the service choice
observations.observed: The service page describes dockside work and a long range of maintenance options, with its Service Request link after those sections.
observations.improvement: Test a request button near the introduction and dockside service. Carry the selected service into the inquiry and compare qualified requests.

limitations: The older print-format inventory URL was unavailable for review. The discrepancy was verified on a current listing; inventory can change.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
